Thanks on all counts -will keep you updated, and attempt to learn the tracking system as fast as can.
On Wed, May 12, 2021 at 12:39 PM Karl Fickenscher <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Sounds great. I am happy for you to take/keep the lead. By the way, if something needs to get to me to clear, l
greatly appreciate these sort of informal head's up emails. We also have a more formal system, with a tracker that is
maintained by the DDI front office admin. management staff. They can be reached via the collective email
"[contact omitted]"
N.B. The good news is that almost every USAID office or bureau has a similar official tracking system with collective
email addresses. The not so good news is that there is no uniform protocol or naming system, so each corresponding
collective email box has a different name: "[contact omitted]" "[contact omitted]" and
"[contact omitted]" for the Agency's Executive Secretariat., just to name a few. Sigh.
Karl Fickenscher (he/him)
USAID (Acting) Assistant Administrator,
Bureau for Development, Democracy and Innovation (DDI)
(Office) [opaque block] I (Mobile)| [opaque block] | [contact omitted]
On Wed, May 12, 2021 at 12:01 PM John Walsh <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Clearance headed your way on the MDM (misinformation/disinformation/malinformation) IPC process. Just wanted
to flag that I'd be keen to stay really engaged on it, either repping DDI or in tandem with you (whichever you prefer).
So crucial to the larger DRG effort, and an area in which I'm generally hoping USAID can provide a lot of the
intellectual firepower.
